description: This file defines the CompareCondition class, which implements a conditional operation based on comparison logic within the MiniLang framework of the Apache OFBiz project. It models the <if-compare> element, supporting condition evaluation based on various comparison operators and types, and includes support for nested sub-operations for true and false branches.

classes.name: CompareCondition
classes.description: Implements the <if-compare> element as a conditional operator that evaluates a comparison between a field value and a specified value, with support for nested sub-operations for true/false branches within the MiniLang framework.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the comparison condition based on the configured operator, operands, and type. Returns true if the comparison holds; false otherwise.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional operation, running sub-operations if the condition is true, or else-subs if the condition is false.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested sub-operations for dependency analysis or documentation.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable representation of the comparison condition for debugging or logging purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns an XML-like string representation of the <if-compare> element with its attributes.
